title: EducationQ: Evaluating LLMs’ Teaching Capabilities Through Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the teaching effectiveness of Large Language Models across various academic disciplines like Law, Business, and Physics. While the dataset includes a 'Philosophy' category, the framework assesses pedagogical capabilities (questioning, feedback, etc.) rather than benchmarking the models' own religious beliefs, faith traditions, or moral/ethical stances.
